emma (sec): reporting: a few customers hit SCIM 403s after the RBAC slug normalization deploy. Can we triage?
noah (idp): looking at identity logs: KMS unwrap failing with encryption_context_mismatch. role_hash changed when we normalized role slugs.
lee (sre): sample log:
```
2026-03-12T11:02:12Z identity ERROR scim deprov extid=starlite|U-444 -> 403
2026-03-12T11:02:12Z identity WARN kms unwrap DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch expected={"role_hash":"r_old"} got={"role_hash":"r_new"}
```
emma (sec): impact? how many tenants/requests?
lee (sre): query: 6 failed deprovisions across starlite and helios in last 45m. queue backed up but no outage.
noah (idp): plan: run targeted rewrap for affected tenants. We'll dry-run first then canary small batch. Tool: `python tools/identity_rewrap.py --tenant starlite --dry-run --batch-size 50`
deploy-bot: identity-rewrap-runner started (canary)
noah (idp): dry-run found 9 candidates. proceeding with canary 10 now.
lee (sre): canary results: 9 rewrapped, 0 failed, SCIM retries succeeded, queue drained.
emma (sec): add audit entry with RBAC tx id and KMS evidence, and add a pause-if-error >5% safeguard to runbook. Compliance needs the trail.
noah (idp): filed IDP-740 to remove mutable role_hash from envelope and use immutable role_id. Will add migration plan + runbook changes.
emma (sec): thanks. recommend postmortem note: root cause = RBAC canonicalization change + KMS envelope dependency; remediation = rewrap automation + switch to immutable context. Closing when compliance acked.
kms-bot: key check: no key rotation in window.
